description: A script for auditing and validating documentation links within a project. It processes markdown files in a 'docs' directory, checks for broken internal, relative, and navigation links, and provides CLI commands to run comprehensive link audits, including anchor link checks. It also handles route normalization, redirects, and sanitizes documentation configuration files.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Recursively traverses the documentation directory to list all files.

methods.name: normalizeSlashes
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes for consistent path formatting.

methods.name: isLocalizedDocPath
methods.description: Checks whether a given path is a localized documentation path based on language codes.

methods.name: isGeneratedTranslatedDoc
methods.description: Determines if a documentation path is a generated translation based on localization patterns.

methods.name: collectNavPageEntries
methods.description: Recursively collects navigation page entries from a nested navigation structure.

methods.name: sanitizeDocsConfigForEnglishOnly
methods.description: Sanitizes the docs configuration object to only include English-only entries.

methods.name: prepareAnchorAuditDocsDir
methods.description: Prepares a temporary directory for anchor link auditing, sanitizing the docs JSON.

methods.name: auditDocsLinks
methods.description: Audits documentation links in markdown files and navigation entries, reporting broken links.

methods.name: runDocsLinkAuditCli
methods.description: CLI command that runs the link audit process, optionally checking anchors.
